name: Download center offers xlsx and csv for every artifact

planSteps.description: Navigate to the upload page: http://127.0.0.1:8501/upload

Set the file input to a file named 'sales.csv' whose UTF-8 content is exactly:
Order ID,Order Date,Customer Name,Region,Qty.,Revenue
ORD-1,09/01/2026,Acme Inc,north,2,"$1,240.00"
ORD-2,31/09/2026,Beta Co,south,3,not available
Click 'Continue to column mapping →', keep the suggested mappings unchanged, click 'Confirm mapping & continue →', then on Processing click 'Run cleaning & validation' and wait for results.
Open the download center by clicking the sidebar navigation item labeled 'Download center'.
The page heading 'Your report package is ready' is visible with three sections titled 'Clean dataset', 'Summary report' and 'Flagged rows'.
The Clean dataset section shows '1 validated rows' and two buttons 'Download .xlsx' and 'Download .csv'.
The Summary report section shows a caption '1 group(s)' and a 'Download .xlsx' button.
The Flagged rows section shows '1 rows' and both 'Download .xlsx' and 'Download .csv' buttons.
